caldav.title: Connect Your Calendar
caldav.subtitle: Follow these steps to see your appointments in your calendar app. This works with Apple Calendar (Mac, iPhone, iPad) and OneCalendar (Windows, Mac, mobile).
caldav.passwordHint: Click the button to copy your password. For security it is not shown here.
caldav.appleStep1: Open the **Calendar** app on your Mac
caldav.appleStep2: In the menu bar, go to **Calendar → Settings** (or press **⌘ ,**), then click the **Accounts** tab
caldav.appleStep3: Click the **+** button at the bottom left to add a new account
caldav.appleStep4: In the provider list, scroll down and select **Other CalDAV Account…**, then click **Continue**
caldav.appleStep6: Fill in the fields using the connection details above: enter your {{val:username:User Name}}, {{pwd:Password}}, {{val:server:Server Address}}, and {{val:path:Server Path}}
caldav.appleStep7: Set the {{val:port:Port}} and check **Use SSL** if shown above, then click **Sign In**
caldav.appleStep8: Your appointments will appear in the calendar sidebar — you can see them right away
caldav.appleImg1: caldav-apple-accounts.png — The Accounts settings panel — click + to add
caldav.appleImg2: caldav-apple-provider.png — Choose 'Other CalDAV Account…' at the bottom
caldav.appleImg3: caldav-apple-form.png — Set Account Type to Advanced and fill in your details
caldav.appleImg4: caldav-apple-result.png — Your appointments now appear in Apple Calendar
caldav.oneCalStep1: Download **OneCalendar** from [onecalendar.nl](https://www.onecalendar.nl/download/store) and open the app
caldav.oneCalStep2: Click the **+** button or go to **Settings** to add a new account
caldav.oneCalStep3: From the account type list, select **CalDAV**
caldav.oneCalStep4: In the **Server** field, paste the {{val:full_url:Full Server URL}} from above (use the copy button)
caldav.oneCalStep6: On the configure screen, make sure your calendar is toggled **on**, then click **Done**
caldav.oneCalStep7: Your appointments will now appear in OneCalendar
caldav.oneCalImg1: caldav-onecal-type.png — Select CalDAV from the account type list
caldav.oneCalImg2: caldav-onecal-form.png — Enter the server URL, username, and password
caldav.oneCalImg3: caldav-onecal-configure.png — Toggle your calendar on and click Done
caldav.oneCalImg4: caldav-onecal-result.png — Your appointments now appear in OneCalendar

welcome.title: You're in.

welcome.description: Repraesent is your all-in-one area for managing leads, booking appointments, and growing your business. This quick tour shows you everything you need to hit the ground running.

dashboard.title:
Your Mission
Control Center
dashboard.subtitle: Everything at a glance.
dashboard.description: The dashboard gives you a real-time pulse on your business. Track today's tasks, monitor lead activity over time, and jump straight into any area service from one clean screen.

leads.title:
Never Lose a
Lead Again
leads.subtitle: Visual pipeline, instant updates.
leads.description: Manage every prospect through a drag-and-drop kanban board or a clean table view. Update statuses, add notes, and track the full journey from first contact to closed deal.

lead-fallback.title:
Reply to Every
Lead Automatically
lead-fallback.subtitle: Set it once, follow up on autopilot.
lead-fallback.description: When a new lead submits your form or books an appointment, Repraesent automatically sends them a personalized reply from your own email address. Configure a custom subject line and HTML body per source — no extra tools needed.

lead-detail.title:
Every Lead,
Fully Documented
lead-detail.subtitle: The full story in one place.
lead-detail.description: Click any lead to open its detail view — see contact info, activity timeline, attached notes, and status history. Edit everything inline and never lose context on a conversation.

appointments.title:
Scheduling on
Autopilot
appointments.subtitle: Let clients book themselves.
appointments.description: Share your personalized booking link and let clients choose their own slot. Set your working hours, define break times, and let Repraesent handle confirmations automatically.

tasks.title:
Stay on Top
of Every Action
tasks.subtitle: Your personal to-do, tied to leads.
tasks.description: Create tasks linked directly to leads so nothing slips through the cracks. Filter by due date, priority, or assignee and always know exactly what needs your attention today.

analytics.title:
Know Who
Visits Your Site
analytics.subtitle: Real website traffic, no guesswork.
analytics.description: The analytics tab is powered by Plausible — a privacy-friendly tool that shows you your website visitors, traffic sources, top pages, and more. See exactly where your audience comes from, all in one clean view.

email.title:
Your Email,
Ready Anywhere
email.subtitle: Connect your inbox in minutes.
email.description: Find your personal email configuration here — server address, port, and login credentials — and follow the step-by-step guide to add your Repraesent mailbox to Outlook, Apple Mail, or any other email client.

settings.title:
Make It
Completely Yours
settings.subtitle: Your area, your rules.
settings.description: Customize your area name, manage team members and their roles, and fine-tune your public booking page. Every detail can be tailored to match your brand and workflow.
